description: tooling notes §9: exact pins, 7-day minimum release age, dev deps grouped weekly, runtime deps and WXT one PR each, never auto-merged.

packageRules.description: Dev dependencies: one grouped PR per week.
Runtime dependencies ship in the extension: one PR each, changelog and diff review.
WXT is 0.x: its own PR; the full E2E suite and the S-01 timing check must pass.
Playwright's bundled Chromium defines the DNR test environment; bumps are their own PR.
Filter-list tooling: a bump must show an explained ruleset diff before merge.
TypeScript stays on 6.x until typescript-eslint supports 7 (spike S-09).
GitHub Actions stay pinned by digest; grouped monthly.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
